description: Run to see who bought a token early and who profited: launch-block snipers, the pool creator, wallets that sold more than they bought (got tokens some other way), and ordinary traders. Reads a token's pool from its first transaction for a set time and lists the wallets that traded it: buys, sells, SOL spent and received, profit, how soon after launch they bought, and launch-block and creator flags. Example: {"token": "<mint address>", "hours": 6}. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.03 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/token_traders.

hours.description: How long after the pool's first transaction to read (default 6). Short (1-2) to study the launch, longer to see who held.

how_many.description: How many wallets to list, most profit first (default 25). Default is fine.

max_trades.description: At most this many transactions are read, oldest first (default 400). Raise it for busy pools; the answer says when the window was cut short.

network.description: Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). "devnet" only for test wallets.

pool.description: The pool to read. Default: the pool with the most liquidity in RugCheck's report. A DEX page or GeckoTerminal's pool address.

token.description: The token whose traders you want. find_token, or the token's address from the user. Never make one up.

name: token_traders
